_meta.purpose: The ONE model config for every BAR economy calculator in this repo. Numbers that are engine truth are NOT written here: each object/action names an engine defName, and the readers resolve metal/energy/buildTime/incomes/storage/build power/speed from the engine dumps listed in `engineDefs`. Only model choices live here (exchange rate, grid calibration, build ranges, which def stands for which model object, the Legion action semantics).
readers: positions/state_api.py         (Legion state engine behind /api/project, navigator, decider, eco_viz)
_meta.parity: bar-calc/parity.json is generated by `python bar-calc/bar_unified.py --write-parity` and verified by `python bar-calc/bar_unified.py --selftest`, `python positions/state_api.py --selftest` and `node splendid_buildSimulator.js --selftest`. Regenerate it whenever this file or an engine dump changes.
_meta.engineSignConvention: energyUpkeep < 0 means the unit PRODUCES energy (legmex -7 = +7 E/s); energyProduction is the explicit generator field; extractsMetal / mexBaseExtract is the mex multiplier (armmex 1.0, legmex 0.75, legmext15 2.0, moho 4.0).

engineDefs.note: headless gex dump (ARM/COR defs + a few leg*), leading `unit_def` block; recoil_2025.06.24, captured 2026-06-09
Legion (leg*) defs + standard mex/solar refs; captured 2026-06-20. Later entries win over earlier files.

Every def the engine reports for a real game, harvested by `python bar-calc/bar_unified.py --harvest-defs` (newest 8v8 replay, headless). The newest units_<dateTime>.json is the default: it is applied last and wins over the two older dumps above.

_notes.energyPerMetal: T1 energy-converter exchange rate (eco_calculator TROI normalisation).
_notes.defaultWind: E/s per turbine when no wind sample is known (All That Glitters average).
_notes.metalSpot: m/s a ×1.0 extractor makes on the reference spot (Legion calibration, 2026-07). armmex → 1.825, legmex → 1.369, moho → 7.3.
_notes.mexMultiplierOverride: per-def mex multiplier that replaces extractsMetal/mexBaseExtract. legmex: the def says 0.0008 (×0.8) but the measured income is ×0.75 ≈ 1.369 m/s (user calibration, 2026-07); state_api/compare were built on the measured value.
_notes.t2MinGen: net E/s the Legion model calls 'T2 ready' (state_api T2_MINGEN).

_notes.mexBudget: how many metal spots a position can ever hold. The metal ceiling, and therefore the phases, come from this. Per-spot RICHNESS and walk time come from the map, never from this number.

gridCalibration._note: Commander build-range circle ≈ 3 start-grid squares (radius) → 1 square = 145/3 ≈ 48.3 elmos. Flip to 1.5 if '3 squares' meant the diameter.

builderProfiles._note: buildRange (elmos) is read from units/*.lua and is not in the engine dumps; speed and build power come from the def.

baseState._note: bar_unified / bar_calc opening state: full 1000/1000 banks. Storage = team base 500 + commander 500 (engine).

_notes.free: part of the starting state: model cost 0, but incomes/storage/build power/speed still come from the def.
_notes.fallback: used ONLY when the def is missing from every engine dump; the resolved type is then flagged provisional (bar_calc's old hand numbers).

aliases._note: faction variants of the model objects (engine defName → objectTypes key). A game's own def overrides costs at runtime (TypeRegistry.absorbDef).

legion._note: positions/state_api.py — the Legion state engine. Costs/incomes resolve from the defs; `replaces` = the slot's previous def (income deltas are new − old); `reclaim` = defs whose metal returns to the bank before the build; `dn` = unit-count deltas; `prereq` = minimum counts.

leg_medmex.label: Upgrade T1 → medmex ({dm:+.2f} m/s, {de:+.0f} E/s swing)

upgrade_t1_moho.label: Upgrade T1 legmex → T2 moho ({metal:.0f}m net, {dm:+.2f} m/s, {de:+.0f} E/s swing)

upgrade_med_moho.label: Upgrade medmex → T2 moho ({metal:.0f}m net, {dm:+.2f} m/s, {de:+.0f} E/s gain)

extraUnits._note: positions/compare.py build options that are not state_api actions.
